notes.title: The First Steam Patch 🛠️
notes.notes:
The first patch for The Alto Collection on Steam is now live.

Including various bug fixes and improvements, this update will ensure you can seamlessly master all 38 Steam achievements as you soar above the windswept dunes and explore the alpine slopes.

This patch includes: 
 🏆 Various Steam achievements and in-game goal fixes.
 🖥️ Improved menu visibility for ultra widescreen players.
 ☁️ Cross-device Cloud Sync improvements.
 🔧 Additional menu navigation bug fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892818/97704056277a1a985ae12531794d66a7f1afb17a.gif

If you encounter any other issues after this update, please get in touch with us at support@builtbysnowman.com. We’re grateful for your feedback!

Don’t forget to share your adventures with us on social media! Follow us on: Twitter/X, TikTok, Instagram & Facebook.

Yours truly,
- Team Alto
